timeline.text: My son writes a math question. The old system matched a template to its shape and printed a card — no explanation.
A kid who doesn't know a quarter equals 25% learns nothing from a shaded bar.
Now every card explains the idea first, names the misconception it fights, then shows one example.
AI agents dig up the real teaching method with a source attached — no citation, no card.
Nine verified teaching ideas live on the wall now, each traceable to a real source.
